# Local patches on the pinned llama.cpp

`mobile/third_party/llama.cpp` is a submodule whose `origin` is the real
upstream (`ggml-org/llama.cpp`) — there is no TALOS-controlled fork to push a
commit to, so a patch here is not committed *inside* the submodule (it would
be an unreachable commit on a fresh clone). It is applied as a plain diff on
top of the pinned SHA instead, exactly as anticipated in
`.claude/DECISIONE-0.1.17.md` §3: "come patch locale sul nostro pin funziona
identica, al costo di riapplicarla a ogni aggiornamento del motore."

## Applying — the build does it

⛔ Since 2026-10-01 the patches are **applied by the Android build**, never by
hand. Patch 0001 used to be applied manually; after a submodule bump it no
longer applied, and the shipped engine silently lost it (Stop during a GPU
prompt read went back from 32 ms to 1.8-3.5 s).

The Gradle task `applicaPatchLlama` (`android/app/build.gradle`) runs before
every `configureCMake*` task and calls `scripts/apply-llama-patches.mjs`:

- if the last patch reverse-applies, the whole chain is already in: nothing to do;
- otherwise each patch is checked and applied **one at a time**, in file-name
  order (`git apply p1 p2` does NOT chain two patches on the same file);
- a patch that does not apply **stops the build** with
  `TALOS_LLAMA_PATCH_NON_SI_APPLICA: <name>`.

By hand, only to check: `node scripts/apply-llama-patches.mjs --check`
(tries the chain on a throw-away clone, the real checkout is untouched).
The same check runs in `npm run test:scripts` (`apply-llama-patches.test.mjs`).

On startup the engine logs, per backend, whether it can stop mid-graph
(`stop a metà grafo: OpenCL = sì`): that is patch 0001 read from the shipped
binary, not from this folder.

## What's here

- **`0001-opencl-abort-callback.patch`** — F-15 / decision 3 from
  `DECISIONE-0.1.17.md`: wires `ggml_backend_set_abort_callback` for the
  OpenCL backend (Metal already has it; OpenCL's `get_proc_address` was
  `NULL`). See that document's decision-3 section for the measured numbers
  and why the check is gated on the batch being multi-token. Re-ported to
  pin `0c1e57098` on 2026-10-01, same content.
- **`0002-opencl-lazy-moe-gdn-ssm.patch`** — point 2 of 2026-10-01
  (`.claude/ragionamento/LEDGER-PUNTO2-GPU-PRONTA-2026-10-01.md`):
  `load_cl_kernels` compiled every OpenCL program at the first buffer
  allocation; measured on Adreno 830 with a dense Q4_K_M model, ~53% of that
  time went to programs the model never uses. The MoE (`add_id`,
  `moe_add_id_glu`, `moe_combine`, `mul_mv_id_*`, the Adreno `gemv/gemm_moe_*`
  and `moe_*` region), Qwen3-Next `gated_delta_net` and Mamba `ssm_*` blocks
  move, unchanged, into `load_cl_kernels_moe/_gdn/_ssm`, compiled on first
  use like upstream's own `load_cl_kernels_argsort`. Depends on 0001
  (same struct region).
- **`0003-opencl-lazy-weight-formats.patch`** — point 2, step 2
  (`.claude/ragionamento/LEDGER-PUNTO2-PASSO2-2026-10-01.md`): the
  `load_cl_kernels` blocks tied to ONE weight format (q4_0, q4_1, q5_0, q5_1,
  q8_0, q1_0, iq4_nl, mxfp4, q4_K, q5_K, q6_K) become guarded block functions,
  loaded by `talos_load_cl_kernels_for_type(ctx, type)` at the start of
  `ggml_cl_mul_mat`, `ggml_backend_opencl_buffer_set_tensor` and
  `ggml_cl_mul_mat_q4_k_glu_fused`. Blocks shared by more than three formats
  stay eager. Generated by `genera-0003.py` (128 blocks, 64 moved). Verified
  on the Pad with `test-backend-ops`: MUL_MAT 1009/1009.
- **`0004-opencl-cache-lazy-fa-programs.patch`** — point 2, step 2: the lazy
  flash-attention compiles called `build_program_from_source_ex`, which never
  reads or writes the on-disk program cache (12 call sites on the pin, 11 on
  upstream master `e358d5917` of 2026-10-01), so every app process paid them
  again. They now go through `talos_build_program_from_source_ex_cached`:
  cache load, else the unchanged `_ex` build, then cache save. Generated by
  `genera-0004.py`.

## Redoing a patch after a pin bump

1. `git -C mobile/third_party/llama.cpp checkout -- .` (clean pin).
2. Apply the patches before it: `git apply ../patches/0001-….patch` …
3. Port the change by hand — for 0002, 0003 and 0004 rerun
   `python genera-000N.py` (each works by anchor and stops if an anchor is
   missing or not unique).
4. `git diff -- <files>` from inside the submodule, **with the default
   `core.autocrlf`** (on Windows the checkout is CRLF; the patch must be LF),
   into the patch file — for a patch that depends on earlier ones, diff
   against the state *after* them, not against the pin.
5. `git -C mobile/third_party/llama.cpp checkout -- .` and
   `node scripts/apply-llama-patches.mjs --check`.
